title: Avocado Night Cream Original vs Fake: How to Check Before You Buy
ex: How to tell an original avocado night cream from a fake: seal, batch number, dates, ingredient list, MRP and licence details, red flags, and how to check a Mirc Glow jar.
rt: Avocado Night Cream Original vs Fake: How to Check | Mirc Glow
rd: Is your avocado night cream original? Check the seal, batch number, dates, ingredients, MRP and licence details, spot red flags, and buy from the brand.
quick: An original avocado night cream comes sealed, with a batch number, mfg and expiry dates, full ingredient list, manufacturer address, MRP and licence details on the label. Buy from the brand's site or official marketplace store, and avoid jars with no label details, very low prices or promises of big changes in days.
facts: Check for an inner seal, batch number, and printed mfg and expiry dates.
A real label shows the ingredients, manufacturer address, MRP and licence details.
Very low prices, refilled jars and quick-change promises are red flags.
Mirc Glow buyers can send a batch number photo on WhatsApp +91 99808 81230 to check a jar.
